name: auto-dev-marketplace
description: Marketplace for auto-dev, an autonomous ticket-to-PR coding pipeline for Claude Code.

plugins.name: auto-dev
plugins.description: Drive a single coding task from ticket to merged pull request autonomously — define, plan, build, verify, and ship — using a purpose-built subagent per delegated job, with a scope call that sizes the pipeline to the task. Stack-agnostic via editable profiles (Elixir ships), with optional Jira/CI/staging integration and human gates before PR and merges.
